title: Why Does Milk Make Bones Strong? The Calcium Fortress!

lines.text: Inside your body stands a super-strong architectural frame: two hundred and six bones!
lines.caps: Inside your body stands a *FRAME: | two hundred and six strong *BONES!

lines.text: They protect your brain, shield your heart, and let you jump eight feet high!
lines.caps: They protect your *BRAIN, | shield your heart, and let you *JUMP | high!

lines.text: Every time you drink milk or eat yogurt, you swallow billions of calcium minerals!
lines.caps: When you drink *MILK, | you swallow billions of calcium *MINERALS!

lines.text: Special construction cells called osteoblasts grab calcium right out of your blood!
lines.caps: Special construction cells called *OSTEOBLASTS | grab calcium from your *BLOOD!

lines.text: They lay down tough collagen rebar, then cement it with hard mineral crystals!
lines.caps: They lay down tough *COLLAGEN, | then cement it with hard *MINERAL | *CRYSTALS!

lines.text: Running, jumping rope, and playing outside tells your bones, Make us stronger!
lines.caps: Running and jumping *ROPE | tells your bones, Make us *STRONGER!

lines.text: And sunshine gives you Vitamin D, the magic key that unlocks calcium absorption!
lines.caps: And sunshine gives you *VITAMIN D, | the key that unlocks calcium *POWER!

lines.text: Build your skeleton fortress today so you can run fast and jump high forever!
lines.caps: Build your skeleton *FORTRESS | so you can jump high *FOREVER!
